_comment: Copy to baseline.config.json at your repo root. The runner auto-detects sensible defaults; override only what you need. With no config file every pack is off and only the always-on rules run; a pack activates from an explicit switch in this file (or --profile <pack>), never from what the tree looks like and never from the descriptor's type.
_project_type: node | service | python | library | docs. Set to 'service' HERE (explicitly) to activate the service pack (OPS-*); the auto-detected type never does.
_makes_external_claims: true activates the claims pack (CLAIM-*: per-claim records with build-state, blast-radius, prior-art). false or absent leaves it off — the right answer for an internal tool with no competitive/novelty claims.
_packs: packs to activate by name: claims | decisions | descriptor | service | advanced. 'descriptor' and 'advanced' (SBOM, code-scanning, mutation testing, symbol-integrity) have no other switch; 'profiles' is the legacy alias for this key, --profile <pack> the CLI form. e.g. ["advanced"]
_want: tools declared present by intent (e.g. ["docker"]): a rule gated on a tool runs when the tool's artifact is in the tree OR the tool is named here, so its rules fire before the first artifact lands. A name that is not a known tool is reported, never silently ignored.
_plugins: PLUG-01..03 (always on, one WARN each, never a FAIL): where each plugin's artifact lives and whether git is expected to ignore it — shown at their defaults. okf-rag's path comes from $BASELINE_OKF_BUNDLE unless set here, and the gitignore question is skipped when the path is outside the repo. baseline reads the artifact's metadata only (exists, file-or-dir, mtime, gitignore state), never its content; a WARN writes .baseline/log/PLUG-0N.log.
_bootstrap_command: the clean-checkout Task-1 command for BUILD-05; must exit 0. Omit to skip.
_claims_file: claims pack: where a legacy monolith is detected (CLAIM-07 flags it; gen migrate-claims explodes it). Claims live in records/claims/.
_decision_globs: a non-empty list activates the decisions pack (CTX-02/07/13/14) and names the decision records it reads. Omit or leave empty to keep the pack off.
_doc_globs: which docs CTX-05 (broken links) and CTX-10 (path-integrity) scan.
_freshness_globs: OPT-IN for CTX-06: docs that must carry a 'last_review_date' in frontmatter. Empty = the rule has nothing to check. e.g. ["docs/architecture.md", "docs/onboarding.md"]
_doc_freshness_days: CTX-06 goes red when a freshness_globs doc's last_review_date is older than this.
_doc_lag_days: CTX-11 goes red when a doc's anchored source code (frontmatter 'sources: [glob]') was committed more than this many days after the doc.
_generated_globs: OPT-IN for CTX-08: generated files that must carry a 'DO NOT EDIT' marker. Empty = the rule has nothing to check. e.g. ["**/*.gen.ts", "docs/api/**"]
_grounding_docs: OPT-IN for CTX-09: required grounding docs that must exist and be non-empty. Empty = the rule has nothing to check. e.g. ["docs/architecture.md", "docs/tech-stack.md"]
_sources_of_truth: CTX-03: one declared home per fact class (status, decisions, ...), so a reader knows where each kind of truth lives.
_prior_art_recheck_days: claims pack, CLAIM-03: a novelty/competitive claim's prior-art pass goes stale after this many days.
